map.📖 查看「检测（联动/报警/维护）服务 使用指南」: View the Detection (Interlock/Alarm/Maintenance) Service User Guide
map.消防联动系统按 6 项检测（火灾探测器、喷淋系统、防排烟系统、防火卷帘与防火门、: The fire interlock system is evaluated item by item across 6 detections (fire detectors, sprinkler system, smoke control system, fire curtains and fire doors, emergency broadcast and fire telephone, elevator emergency descent), with 1 point counted per abnormality; a total of 0 means the interlock is normal, 1 to 2 abnormalities is a minor hazard, and 3 or more is a major hazard; the interlock response is required to act within 30 seconds after alarm confirmation, detectors must be cleaned and calibrated at least once every 2 years, and the sprinkler terminal test pressure must be not lower than 0.05 MPa.
map.消防联动系统检测评估（6项系统联动检测）: Fire interlock system detection assessment (6-item system interlock detection)
map.消防联动控制系统检测中，按火灾探测器、喷淋、防排烟、防火卷帘、广播电话、电梯迫降: In fire interlock control system detection, scores are given item by item for fire detectors, sprinklers, smoke control, fire curtains, broadcast telephone and elevator emergency descent.
map.年度检测与故障排查时，用评分快速判断联动是正常、基本正常还是严重故障。: During annual detection and fault troubleshooting, the scoring quickly judges whether the interlock is normal, basically normal or seriously faulty.
map.评分越高代表失效子系统越多，需列出具体维修项并限期处置。: The higher the score the more subsystems have failed, so the specific repair items must be listed and handled within a deadline.
map.算例：全部正常（各项 0 分）: Worked example: all normal (all items 0 points)
map.故障评分 = 0 / 18 → 『联动正常』，所有联动系统检测正常，建议按规定周: Fault score = 0 / 18 -> 'interlock normal', all interlock systems test normal, and regular detection and maintenance on schedule is recommended.
map.算例：单系统故障（2 分）: Worked example: single system fault (2 points)
map.如仅『火灾探测器』一项记 2 分，总分 = 2 ≤ 4 → 『基本正常』，需维修: For example, if only 'fire detectors' scores 2 points, the total = 2 <= 4 -> 'basically normal', that item needs repair and re-inspection; any item >=2 is flagged as 'needs repair'.
map.评分超过多少算严重故障？: Above how many points counts as a serious fault?
map.本工具约定总分 0 为联动正常、≤4 为基本正常、>4 为严重故障（满分 18，: This tool uses a total of 0 for interlock normal, <=4 for basically normal, and >4 for serious fault (18 in total, 0 = all normal). A single subsystem item scoring >=2 is treated as needing repair.
map.联动检测多久做一次？: How often is the interlock detection done?
map.通常按消防法规与维保合同，联动控制系统每年至少进行一次全面检测；重大改动或故障修: Usually per fire regulations and the maintenance contract, the interlock control system needs a full detection at least once a year; after major modifications or fault repairs a specific re-inspection is also needed, and records should be kept.
